# Wasabi Drive backend - GitHub Copilot instructions (Phase 8D-D, Task 1B)

**Active task:** align the production v2 thumbnail backfill and read-only preflight with Task 1A's shared, validated source-bucket enrollment. Add deliberate root/prefix scope selection and privacy-safe diagnostics. Prepare, but do not apply, a reusable Wasabi permission plan. **Mocked code and documentation only; no live access, policy changes, backfill runs, deployment, or production promotion.**

## Authority, baseline, and workflow

- The owner makes architecture, security-boundary, and rollout decisions. Follow `Wasabi-Drive-CURRENT-IMPLEMENTATION-HANDOFF.md`, revision `2026-11-23.2`, and the accompanying Task 1B implementation prompt; newer explicit owner decisions take precedence.
- Task 1A is owner-confirmed: local `npm test` passed, its pull request was merged into `master`, and the existing TEST application was smoke-tested successfully. It **has not been promoted to PRD**, and this task must not promote or enable it there.
- Start from the **actual latest `origin/master`**. The last source archive available to the architecture review was the revised Task 1A feature archive, not an independent post-merge `master` checkout. Verify `AGENTS.md`, `git branch --show-current`, `git rev-parse HEAD`, `git status --short`, and pertinent source/tests. Report substantive differences before editing.
- Create a new focused branch, suggested `feature/v2-backfill-scope-alignment`. Do not work or commit on `master`. Leave implementation changes uncommitted for owner/ChatGPT review; do not push, merge, create a PR, deploy, or modify CI environments.
- Use Node.js 24, CommonJS, existing Express 4/API Gateway REST, Serverless Framework v4, and the existing configuration/service/storage boundaries. Do not introduce new databases, frameworks, managed services, queues, or generalized policy engines.
- Preserve all existing tests. Use isolated synthetic data, stubs, mocks, and private temporary test paths. Run `npm test`, relevant `node --check`, and `git diff --check` locally; report real outcomes. Do **not** run `npm run test:integration`, live CLI scans, Docker backfills, cloud calls, or policy management.

- Existing v1 13-photo pilot, completed Sydney v2 100-photo pilot, and their generated private objects and historical state. Never touch `/state/sydney-100/` or any actual checkpoint, audit, backup, Docker volume or local credential.
- Task 1A's `src/thumbnail/source-enrollment.js`: pure validation of exact `{bucket, region}` pairs against an explicit stage, derived bucket, internal buckets and excluded buckets. The API's opt-in `THUMBNAIL_API_V2_SOURCE_BUCKETS_JSON` and legacy fallback remain separate; do not change API browsing/authentication without a demonstrated, tightly scoped compatibility requirement.
- V2 contract: WebP, 200 x 190 centre crop, quality 80, metadata stripped, no enlargement, 25 MiB source maximum, deterministic key bound to region/bucket/complete key/normalized ETag. Preserve v1 precedence in API signing and original-image fallback.
- Production backfill v1 defaults and Tokyo restriction; `--recipe v2` must remain explicit. Production v2 may use any supported, **enrolled** source region in opt-in mode; region support is not authorization. Derived destination remains one fixed private PRD bucket in `ap-southeast-1`.
- Existing storage-side source/destination binding, dynamically approved derived keys from validated source metadata, conditional source GET `IfMatch`, conditional derived PUT `IfNoneMatch: "*"`, and no source writes or deletes.
- Existing shared writer lock, v1/v2 checkpoint and append-only audit formats, processing fingerprint, durable write-intent/outcome ordering, corrupt/unknown fail-closed behavior, and recipe-specific state paths.

## Task 1B implementation boundary

1. Reuse the Task 1A pure validator for local v2 PRD backfill and read-only preflight. Use one small transitional local-only configuration for both tools: `THUMBNAIL_PRD_V2_SOURCE_BUCKETS_JSON` (approved `{bucket,region}` pairs), `THUMBNAIL_PRD_V2_EXCLUDED_BUCKETS_JSON` (all protected TEST/internal/operational buckets other than the fixed derived destination), and `THUMBNAIL_PRD_V2_DERIVED_BUCKET` (the known fixed private destination). Require the excluded list and derived identity explicitly for PRD opt-in; backfill must match the derived identity to its existing fixed destination config. Do not silently reuse API credentials or assume API enrollment is sufficient authorization for a different identity. Keep the actual source list and private operational identifiers outside Git.
2. In opt-in PRD v2 mode, require validated protected/internal/excluded bucket inputs, including the fixed derived bucket, other internal-derived/operational storage and TEST buckets. Never rely only on bucket-name pattern matching, and never treat invalid/absent enrollment as account-wide access. Preserve strict legacy behavior when opt-in is **absent**. Keep v1 entirely unchanged.
3. Separate **enrollment** (which bucket/region can be read) from **job scope** (which prefix or root to scan). Add an explicit `--whole-bucket` selector that is mutually exclusive with `--prefix`. Require `--recipe v2` for the expanded preflight behavior; preserve the existing preflight default/legacy arguments when recipe is omitted. Missing, empty, malformed or ambiguous selection must fail closed; do not silently map an absent prefix to root. Preserve exact object-key/prefix identity, without URL decoding, path normalization, auto-appended separators, or prefix expansion.
4. Update every relevant validation layer, not just the CLI: `src/thumbnail/production-backfill.js`, `src/thumbnail/production-backfill-region.js`, `src/storage/thumbnail-prd-backfill-wasabi.js`, `src/thumbnail/preflight-scope.js`, `src/thumbnail/production-preflight.js`, `src/storage/thumbnail-preflight-wasabi.js`, and both CLI scripts. Pass validated per-job scope to the storage adapters. Keep independent storage-side checks and bounded `ListObjectsV2` requests.
5. For Task 1B, **keep the production backfill cap at 10 examined objects and page size at 1-10**. Keep the preflight's existing maximum of 1000 objects and its existing page-size limits. Larger jobs, sequential campaign continuation, audit scalability, and coordinator scripts belong to Task 2.
6. Add minimal sanitized error classes/codes and no-progress/zero-examined context where reliably known. Distinguish empty scope or completed cursor from configuration rejection, provider denial, regional failure and invalid/unknown state; do not invent root-cause claims. No private filenames, bucket names, full object keys, credentials, secrets, request headers or raw provider exceptions in public CLI summaries.
7. Document new opt-in/legacy configuration, whole-bucket selection, state isolation, dry-run limitations, TEST-before-PRD gates and rollback in `README.md`/`.env.example`. Update this instructions file if scope changes. Prepare only a **non-applied** reusable policy plan with synthetic placeholders; real JSON resources require the approved buckets and a sanitized review of effective existing user/group/bucket policies.

## Security and rollout gates

- Production backfill continues to use dedicated `THUMBNAIL_PRD_BACKFILL_*` credentials with no default AWS provider chain. Preflight continues to use its independent `THUMBNAIL_PRD_PREFLIGHT_*` read-only credentials. Do not cross-wire or reuse credentials, inspect their values, or log them.
- Read/list source buckets only; derived write permission only within the fixed private `v2/*` namespace when later approved. No source PUT/DELETE, derived DELETE, public access, S3 wildcard-account access, policy modification, or API runtime writer permission.
- `HeadObject` uses `s3:GetObject`; absence-vs-denial behavior must be verified with Wasabi, not assumed from Amazon S3. A conditional PUT request is not a provider-enforced create-only policy. Denials and ambiguous writes must fail closed.
- This PR must not enable source enrollment in production API configuration, alter live Wasabi policy/credentials, provision cloud infrastructure, execute Docker, run a live dry-run, or run a production campaign. Deployed TEST Task 1A behavior remains stable. No frontend change.
- Future automatic discovery/notification/reconciliation is the next **separate** phase after the historical backfill; do not build it now. Keep source-selection validation independent of local checkpoint paths so an approved automatic source rule can eventually replace the transitional enrollment input.

## Mocked acceptance tests and report

- Exact enrolled vs unapproved/forbidden bucket; correct vs wrong region; PRD internal/TEST exclusions; same-region distinct source/destination; Tokyo v1 rules unchanged; v2 opt-in vs legacy behavior; malformed/empty settings fail closed.
- Literal nested prefix, explicit root, root-level objects, folder markers, malformed paths, `--prefix`/`--whole-bucket` conflict, missing flags, no accidental all-bucket scan, and no prefix normalization. Both CLI and storage-layer rejection must be covered.
- Preflight maintains read-only metadata listing with honest `complete`/`capped` and correct zero-examined behavior; backfill retains ten-object cap, pagination checks, conditional writes, fingerprint/checkpoint/audit compatibility, and stop-on-unsafe-outcome.
- Only known sanitized categories appear in output; provider denial is never reported as successful empty listing. Verify no accidental extra provider requests for rejected scopes.
- Report the exact changed files, new config/interface, legacy migration behavior, tests/totals, potential incompatibilities, and any decisions still requiring the owner. Stop on uncertain permissions or durable-state compatibility. Leave changes uncommitted.
